phasing_details.phase_detail: Change of Use / Fit Out - indicative only

description: Flexible use of the ground floor and basement unit for either continued Class E use or Sui Generis use as a premium cocktail bar.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Location plan; 2014; Cover letter dated 13 March 2026 prepared by Rolfe Judd Planning; Operational Management Plan titled "Schofield's Bar London Operations Manual" prepared by Scholfield's; 2011 Rev.A; 2012 Rev.A; 2013 Rev.A.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - The proposed use shall be undertaken in accordance with the Operational Management Plan document 'Schofield's Bar London Operations Manual'. Any revisions to the Operational Management Plan must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, A4, C5, TC2 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried out outside the following times:

08:00 - 00:30 Mondays to Saturdays
09:00 - 00:30 Saturdays
10:00 - 23:30 Sundays

Unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority through approval of the Operational Management Plan required by Condition 3. 

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, A4, TC2 and TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - No music shall be played on the premises or amplified sound generated in such a way as to be audible outside the premises a) at a level that gives rise to public nuisance, nor b) except for short periods of time as may be reasonably required.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1, A4, TC2, TC4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
